policy: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery for most products.
Items must be unused, in original packaging, and include all accessories.
Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after quality check.
Defective or damaged items are eligible for free replacement or full refund.
Certain items are non-returnable: personal care products, gift cards, and software activation keys.
If the return is due to buyer remorse, return shipping charges may apply.
